paite: Mi tengtengte aw, na khut uh beng unla; nopna aw in Pathian kiang ah kikou un.
heading: Korah Tate La / Vaihawmpa Tungnungpen
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. Oh clap your hands, all you nations. Shout to God with the voice of triumph!

paite: TOUPA Tungnungpen akihtakhuai a; leitung tengteng ah kumpipa thupitak ahi.
english: For Yahweh Most High is awesome. He is a great King over all the earth.

paite: Ama'n michih i nuai uah azou ding a, i khenuai ah namte azou ding hi.
english: He subdues nations under us, and peoples under our feet.

paite: Ama'n i gouluah ding hon telsak ding a, a-it Jakob leh asuanpen gam mah ahi. Selah
english: He chooses our inheritance for us, the glory of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.

paite: Kikou aw toh Pathian apaitou a, TOUPA pengkul ging toh apaitou hi.
english: God has gone up with a shout, Yahweh with the sound of a trumpet.

paite: Pathian phat in la sa unla, phat in la sa un; i Kumpipa phat in la sa unla, phat in la sa un.
english: Sing praises to God! Sing praises! Sing praises to our King! Sing praises!

paite: Pathian lah leitung tengteng Kumpipa ahi ngal a, theisiam a phat in la sa un.
english: For God is the King of all the earth. Sing praises with understanding.

paite: Pathian in namte tung ah vai ahawm a, Pathian alaltutphah siangthou ah atu hi.
english: God reigns over the nations. God sits on his holy throne.

paite: Abraham' Pathian mite hi ding in michih lak a miliante a- omkhawm ua, leitung kumpipate Pathian a ahi ngal ua, nakpitak a pahtawi in amah a-om hi.
english: The princes of the peoples are gathered together, the people of the God of Abraham. For the shields of the earth belong to God. He is greatly exalted!
